verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Adyen offers webhooks to notify on asynchronous status changes and a separate Disputes API for retrieving dispute information, indicating the underlying capability for event-driven automation exists. However, the evidence never explicitly documents POS-specific webhook event types (authorized, captured, refunded, disputed) or shows a subscription/configuration example for in-person payment flows. missing for 10: explicit list of POS lifecycle webhook event types, subscription/configuration walkthrough, and confirmation that disputes trigger webhook notifications rather than only API retrieval.
